name: EXM_EXCH_RATE_OPTIONS_
description: This table contains the conversion rate policies for business units.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_ID
columns.description: This is the exchange rate option row identifier.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: DFLT_EXCHANGE_RATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the conversion rate appears by default for cash transactions in an expense report.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: The source of a currency conversion rate, such as user defined, spot, or corporate.

columns.name: WARNING_TOLERANCE
columns.description: A percentage that, when added to the cash limit, defines the warning amount. If the expense amount is more than the warning amount, a warning displays.

columns.name: ERROR_TOLERANCE
columns.description: A percentage that, when added to the cash limit, defines the error amount. If the expense amount is greater than the error amount, the expense report is not submitted.

columns.name: DISP_WARNING_TO_USER
columns.description: Indicator of whether a conversion rate policy violation warning is displayed to the user.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
